data.exact_reserve_text: The syndicate released prior year reserves of $2.9m during 2015 (2014: release of $4.6m).
data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate reported a release of prior year reserves of $2.9m in 2015 (2014: $4.6m release). This represents a modest favourable development against opening gross claims outstanding of $296.5m (approximately -0.98%). No specific prior-year events or detailed per-line movements are disclosed alongside this statement; the release is described generically as a prior year reserve release.

data.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding taken from Balance Sheet (Claims outstanding, comparative column). Prior-year development amount sourced from narrative statement 'released prior year reserves of $2.9m' (Strategic report). No explicit gross 'movement in prior years' reconciliation line was found; the gross claims development table is present but does not provide prior-diagonal monetary cells to compute PYD reliably. The narrative does not explicitly state gross vs net; treated as gross for reporting but with moderate confidence.
